“%1$s” was imported.\n\nA voice can also have a config file (%2$s) with its language and quality info. Import it too?

Get voices

• Download voices from the catalog: pick a language and quality, then tap Download.
• Import your own: choose a .onnx model file, plus its .onnx.json config file if you have one.

Use a voice

• Tap an installed voice to preview it, set it as the active voice, or delete it.
• The active voice is the one Piper uses by default.

Use Piper in other apps

• Open the system text-to-speech settings and select Piper as the preferred engine. Then any app that speaks (screen readers, book readers) can use your Piper voices.
System TTS settings are not available on this device.

Piper for Android: offline neural text-to-speech, by Ihor Shevchuk.\n\nThe speech engine is the original Piper (piper1-gpl), running fully on your device. No network needed after a voice is downloaded.
